commits_data.title: gsm_sim: Show unknown APDU bytes
commits_data.message:
gsm_sim: Show unknown APDU bytes

Add expert info for unknown bytes after the known command APDU.

Fix SIMtrace issues after lastest changes. For the default APDU
parser it's not possible to know if the APDU contains command
"Lc Data" or command "Le" with response "Data".
